area.title: Shelter area
area.step1: Upload your animals from {upload}, just like any pet.
area.step2: Once the photo is approved, open the pet's page from {profile} and add the {card}.
area.step3: The pet appears in "Looking for a home" and in duels with the ribbon. Requests arrive below.
area.confirmClose: Yes, close the shelter and remove all adoption profiles
area.pendingText: Thanks! A moderator checks the details (usually within a couple of days). If needed, we'll write to {email}.
area.pendingHint: Meanwhile you can already upload your animals: the "Looking for a home" ribbon turns on after verification.
area.rejected: The request wasn't approved: {reason}. Fix the details and send it again.
area.applyText: For kennels, shelters, catteries and associations that do adoptions. We check that the association exists: tax code, email and phone are only seen by moderators. On @:{'site.name'} you just adopt: no sales, no prices.
